name: Aqua Teen Hunger Force
description: The surreal adventures of three anthropomorphic fast food items: Master Shake, Frylock and Meatwad, and their human nextdoor neighbor, Carl Brutananadilewski.

videos.title: Rabbot
videos.overview: The original rough cut version of the pilot episode "Rabbot". Originally stealth aired on December 30, 2000, six months prior to the launch of Adult Swim.

videos.title: Assisted Living Dracula
videos.overview: In "Bus of The Undead" (season 1 episode 3), Master Shake is watching a b-grade horror movie called "Assisted Living Dracula." The movie (all 1 minutes 22 seconds of it), is included as an Easter Egg in Disc 2 of the ATHF DVD Volume 1

videos.title: Spacecataz
videos.overview: The Mooninites and the Plutonians have at it!

videos.title: Aqua Teen Hunger Force Colon Movie Film for Television
videos.overview: The April Fool's Day prank broadcast of the "Aqua Teen Hunger Force Colon Movie Film" twelve days prior to release in theaters. Only the first few minutes of the movie played as expected, while the remainder was muted and scaled down to a tiny overlay at the lower left of the screen as the regular Adult Swim programming played. Various pop-ups with sound effects periodically displayed during the broadcast to explain the promotional event.

videos.title: Adult Swim Kids Presents: Revenge of the Mooninites
videos.overview: An April Fool's version of the episode Revenge of the Mooninites, with children dubbing all the voices and changes made to the script and animation to remove the naughtier elements.

videos.title: The Return of Handbanana
videos.overview: A perverted presence from the past reappears to re-assault Carl.

videos.title: The Broodwrap
videos.overview: The devilish deli meat demon returns, wrapped in a new cloak of roasted tomato darkness.

videos.title: MC Pee Pants University
videos.overview: MC Pee Pants keeps it real and keeps it shady with a new plan for preying on pensioners.

videos.title: Moonmaster 9: Beware the Gorgotron
videos.overview: The Mooninites are invading your gameplay!

videos.title: Frat Aliens Hell Week
videos.overview: It’s ‘Hell Week’ with your favorite Frat Aliens, and they’ve got some new pledges under their fins.

videos.title: Breakie B
videos.overview: Cybernetic Ghost of Christmas Past from the Future is back to save the future from the past.

videos.title: Markula the Slumlord
videos.overview: The Plutonians, Oglethorpe and Emory, go property hunting for a secret base and get caught in a slumlord's web

videos.title: Merlo's Revenge Upon Unbelievable Ron
videos.overview: Merlo the magician recruits Carl to help him enact revenge against his old sidekick, Unbelievable Ron.

videos.title: The Dumbest Doll of All
videos.overview: 18 years after Master Shake throws him off a cliff, Happy Time Harry returns home to end it all.

videos.title: Handbanana's Demise
videos.overview: Carl sets a trap for Handbanana and takes him to the vet to be neutered, spayed, and possibly put to sleep.

videos.title: Boston
videos.overview: The episode parodies the 2007 Bomb scare. This episode was pulled by Turner Legal to avoid further controversy surrounding the incident. It was leaked online in 2015. It is the only episode of the series that was never formally released.

videos.title: Future Wolf II: Never Cry Wolf: Origin of the Series
videos.overview: An ATHF Volume Two DVD extra. It is a strange short film that tells an untrue story about how Aqua Teen Hunger Force came into existence.

videos.title: The Faces in Front of the Throats That Make the Voices That Speak Into the Microphone
Aqua Teen Hunger Force Responds to the Critics
ATHF Movie Premiere with Space Ghost
Learn to Shred Like the Master
Tera Patrick Eats a Hot Dog
Live Action Behind the Scenes: The Making of 12 Minutes of Television That Changed Television for 12 Minutes
Rubberman Behind the Scenes: Your Mom and Uncle Sing about Condoms
Terror Phone II: The Legend of Rakenstein
Live Action Carl: The Dave Long Story: Shave Your Head, Grow a Mustache and Gain 80lbs for a Shot at Fame
Rabbot
videos.overview: Dr. Weird proclaims he has obtained the funds to build a Rabbot to solve the world's "vegetable problem". Dr. Weird tells Steve to spray it in the eyes with French perfume and after the spraying, the Rabbot gets annoyed and escapes the lab.

videos.title: Escape from Leprechaupolis
videos.overview: Leprechauns use Dr. Weird's Rainbow Machine to mug people from afar, apparently for shoes. Although they don't end up with anything more than a gold chain, a Banarama tape with no case and rollerskates.

videos.title: Bus of the Undead
videos.overview: Dr. Weird creates a mutant moth/human called Mothmonsterman, but it flies out of the giant hole left by Rabbot and flies toward the Aqua Teen's house, craving the bright light it sees coming from within. When the light is switched off, Mothmonsterman does everything in his power to frighten Master Shake into turning it back on.

videos.title: Balloonenstein
videos.overview: Meatwad gets new electric powers thanks to Shake's shenanigans, which make everyone hate him because they either die or get hurt when they're near him. But it's stil useful for getting revenge on Shake.

videos.title: Space Conflict from Beyond Pluto
videos.overview: Frylock attempts to make contact with aliens and is successful... but there's only two problems. First, the aliens want to take over Earth, and second, they're too stupid to pull it off.

videos.title: Ol' Drippy
videos.overview: Shake makes a large mess in the kitchen and refuses to clean it, eventually resulting in the formation of a new lifeform which Meatwad gleefully names "Ol' Drippy".  Shake becomes jealous of the attention that the new character receives.

videos.title: Revenge of The Mooninites
videos.overview: The Mooninites are back and this time they've got a belt that gives them superpowers from the band Foreigner.

videos.title: MC Pee Pants
videos.overview: Subliminal messages in the music Meatwad has been listening to draw the team to a warehouse, where they find out that rap artist behind the music is actually a giant spider.

videos.title: Dumber Dolls
videos.overview: Meatwad gets a new doll, Happy Time Harry, which has a dreadfully bitter and jaded personality. Happy Time Harry's time is up when his negativity begins to affect everyone.

videos.title: Bad Replicant
videos.overview: Master Shake is kidnapped by returning characters Emory and Oglethorpe.  The two aliens replace him with a "replicant", but Frylock and Meatwad soon realize that the Shake "replicant" doesn't resemble Shake at all.

videos.title: Circus
videos.overview: Master Shake sells Meatwad to the circus, but when Meatwad becomes a huge big top success, Shake gets jealous and tries to get in on the act. It's a battle of the freaks!

videos.title: Love Mummy
videos.overview: Frylock discovers a mummy in the crawlspace under the house. The mummy begins to exhort his bratish favors from Frylock by threatening him with an ancient Egyptian curse.

videos.title: Dumber Days
videos.overview: Meatwad's brain is discovered to be nothing more than a toy with a jingle bell in it. After Meatwad goes through a brief depression, Carl gets him a new live brain against Frylock's will. With his new brain, Meatwad begins to grow smarter and larger.

videos.title: Interfection
videos.overview: While looking up teeth conspiracies (and Metallica) on the internet in Frylock's room, Shake and Meatwad make various popup windows appear in Frylock's room which start to spread throughout the house.

videos.title: PDA
videos.overview: Shake is missing his Personal Digital Assistant. The gang proceeds to look in the Adirondack mountains and in Carl's pool for it, until finally they confront the thief. If he IS a thief. Or maybe Shake's just greedy and wants his PDA.

videos.title: Mail Order Bride
videos.overview: As a Christmas present to themselves, Shake and Carl split the cost of a mail-order bride from Russia.  Unfortunately, once she gets a look at her new "husbands" she freaks out and locks herself in Carl's house, leaving Carl stuck outside.

videos.title: Cybernetic Ghost of Christmas Past from the Future
videos.overview: Carl is visited by the Cybernetic Ghost Of Christmas Past From The Future and learns that his house is built on an elfin graveyard, thus causing his pool to fill with blood. Then the Cybernetic Ghost Of Christmas Past From The Future recounts a long story about the first Christmas.

videos.title: Super Birthday Snake
videos.overview: Meatwad asks for a bunny for his birthday, but Master Shake gets him the wrong gift... a snake! Frylock accidentally kills Meatwad and Master Shake after the snake eats them.  Free from his friends, Frylock takes up a life of crime and sex.

videos.title: Super Hero
videos.overview: Master Shake decides to become a superhero named "The Drizzle".  In his attempt to be noticed, he douses himself in toxic waste, hands out "Drizzle Phones" and orders a costume.

videos.title: Super Bowl
videos.overview: After Meatwad finds two Super Bowl tickets inside a bag of chips, everyone tries to get on his good side in order to claim the second ticket.  Soon the contest goes to Meatwad's head and he tries to take advantage of Carl and Shake.

videos.title: Super Computer
videos.overview: Frylock invents a new, ridiculously advanced super computer but Shake's incompetence sends it careening into Carl's house. Frylock builds another one but the advanced technologies involved accidentally send the machine back in time!

videos.title: Super Model
videos.overview: Master Shake comes back from a trip to Guatemala with a new nose.  With his new-found "beauty", Shake sets out to make himself the best damn looking person in the world.

videos.title: Super Spore
videos.overview: While The Aqua Teens are chilling in Carl's Pool one day, an alien tentacle reaches out and grabs Shake. The alien uses Shake as his method to speak with the others. The problem is, the alien only speaks Japanese. The alien is also not housebroken. Frylock takes it upon himself to civilize this new comer from space.

videos.title: Super Sir Loin
videos.overview: Meatwad goes on a hunger strike "For the Shorties" due to the subliminal messages in Sir Loin's new album.  However, he doesn't stop there, ravaging all the food in the house for Sir Loin's "Hunger Drive".  Something seems strangely familiar.

videos.title: Super Squatter
videos.overview: When Shake forgets (or decides not) to pay all the bills, all the utilities and accessories get cut off. Instead of paying the bills himself, Frylock decides to teach Shake a lesson and leaves the house with any type of utility. Shake simply takes refuge in Carl's house.

videos.title: The Meat Zone
videos.overview: Somehow, Meatwad develops an amazing ability to see the future upon touching someone. Shake decides to exploit him for loads of money while Frylock is out to prove its all fake.

videos.title: Super Trivia
videos.overview: Sick of losing every week at team trivia to his arch enemy, Wayne the Brain, Frylock decides to up his game. He subjects Shake and Meatwad to his special kind of tutoring and drag Carl along for the ride.

videos.title: Universal Remonster
videos.overview: Emory and Oglethorpe pay the Aqua Teens another visit, only this time they decide to steal their cable using the Fargate, and control what they're watching using the Universal Remonster.

videos.title: Total Re-Carl
videos.overview: Frylock's new invention inadvertently destroys Carl's body leaving only an infuriated head. Frylock decides to rebuild Carl's body by any means necessary which includes grave robbing and robot building.

videos.title: Revenge of the Trees
videos.overview: With a huge vat of oil left over from his Labor Day feast, Shake creates a foul environment in the Aqua Teen's front lawn.  With the help of Carl, the two dump the oil in the woods, but pay a hefty price in return.

videos.title: Spirit Journey Formation Anniversary
videos.overview: Shake puts together a metal version of the "Birthday Song" hoping to cash in on the royalties.  But, when Zakk Wylde come looking for his cut of the money, things go all wrong for Shake.

videos.title: The Shaving
videos.overview: It's Halloween at the Aqua Teen headquarters and a monster comes down from the attic...to get his mail. Much to his chagrin, the monster is unable to scare anyone - until he reveals a gruesome secret.

videos.title: Broodwich
videos.overview: Shake uncovers a delicious, demoniacally possessed submarine sandwich in his front yard. A voice tells him if he eats the whole thing, he will be killed. Shake must battle the Last Temptation of the Broodwich or lose his life.

videos.title: Kidney Car
videos.overview: With his prized car destroyed, Carl is left with no choice but to donate it to the Kidney Foundation.  In a bad twist of fate, the Kidney Foundation donates the car to Meatwad.

videos.title: The Cubing
videos.overview: The Wisdom Cube claims to hold all the known knowledge in the universe, but it seems he only possesses a knack for tiresome anecdotes. Frylock has his doubts if this is all for real.

videos.title: Frat Aliens
videos.overview: DP and Skeeter, fraternity brothers from outer space, get lost along the way back home and crash on earth. They quickly become unwanted and Skeeter pulls out but leaves DP behind to be handled by the Aqua Teens.

videos.title: The Clowning
videos.overview: Carl gets a new head of hair and doesn't wait to show it off to the Aqua Teens. However, when the hair begins to make Carl act strangely, Frylock fears the worst. Carl's been clowned!

videos.title: The Dressing
videos.overview: While sitting down to eat their Thanksgiving dinner one week after Thanksgiving, the Aqua Teens are interrupted by a robotic turkey who is determined to save their turkey and take it back in time in the time rift.

videos.title: The
videos.overview: After Shake's antics finally push him too far, Frylock leaves the Aqua Teen's house. Without Frylock around to hold him back, Shake lays waste to the house and tortures Meatwad as he never has before. Carl soon feels the effects of not having Frylock around.

videos.title: The Cloning
videos.overview: After breaking one too many TVs, we learn that Frylock has been cloning them the entire time.  The newest TV seems a bit off, and they find a new use for the cloning machine.

videos.title: The Last One
videos.overview: Several of the Aqua Teens' enemies gather on the moon to plot their next move. After a long while, things don't seem to progress and all that has been managed are the deaths of half the members.

videos.title: Video Ouija
videos.overview: Meatwad's new video game allows him to contact the dead. But by the time Shake commits suicide in order to haunt the Video Ouija realm himself, Meatwad has already lost interest in digital seances.

videos.title: Unremarkable Voyage
videos.overview: When Meatwad eats a very important microchip, Frylock must shrink down to retrieve it. However, while shrunk, Shake seizes the moment to capture him and shrink Carl and Meatwad. All three of them are now at Shake's mercy.

videos.title: Mooninites 3: Remooned
videos.overview: The Mooninites return again, only this time to cash in a check. Seeing their cash, Meatwad and Shake both try to impress the Mooninites so they get some of the dough.

videos.title: Gee Whiz
videos.overview: A billboard with the face of a religious icon seems to have given Meatwad the gift of a child.  Frylock doesn't trust the "pregnancy" is all it's cracked up to be.

videos.title: EDork
videos.overview: Shake's E-Helmet is loaded with superfluous gadgets, but somehow an add-on player piano isn't enough to satisfy his lust for convenience.

videos.title: Little Brittle
videos.overview: MC Pee Pants is back! Reincarnated as an old man in a retirement home, he is releasing music to get people to come visit him and, of course, Meatwad falls pray to his subliminal messages. But is there something else he wants?

videos.title: Robositter
videos.overview: Frylock and Shake are forced to take jobs at a restaurant in the mall and leave Meatwad under the care of Carl. Frylock comes home after their first day to find Carl had ignored Meatwad completely and that Meatwad had helped himself to the medicine cabinet. Frylock then builds a robot babysitter for Meatwad.

videos.title: Mooninites 4: The Final Mooning
videos.overview: Meatwad has a new video game to play. Upon beating it, the Mooninites drop in to crown him the Moon Master and call on him to help them defeat a great foe.

videos.title: Diet
videos.overview: With a case of beer on the line, Meatwad, Carl, and Shake all battle to see who can loose the most weight. Carl uses a special candy bar to drop pounds while Frylock makes Meatwad lose weight the manual way. Shake just works to impede the others.

videos.title: Dusty Gozongas
videos.overview: In an attempt to bring the Olympics to New Jersey, Shake destroys the gas line. When Frylock calls the city to fix it, they send over Dusty Gonzongas, the hottest stripper from the Wild Wild Chest club thus causing plenty of tension between Shake and Carl.

videos.title: T-Shirt of the Living Dead
videos.overview: An ancient and all powerful T-shirt gives Meatwad amazing powers to see and know all. Meatwad uses his new powers to summon Santa Claus and a hoard of Easter Bunnies.

videos.title: Hypno-Germ
videos.overview: When Hypno-Germs invade Shake's brain, they force him to do a number of insane things. Frylock uses Mexican jumping-beans to combat the germs in Shakes head with a theatrical spectacular!

videos.title: Carl
videos.overview: When the Aqua Teens go to Panama City for a vacation, Meatwad leaves Carl to babysit Dewey, Vanessa, and Boxy Brown. At first, Carl thinks not having the Aqua Teens around is great, but soon realizes that hanging around the neighborhood by himself is a real drag.Meanwhile, in Panama City, Meatwad tries to start a comedy act, Frylock tries to get some action, and Shake loafs around the hotel room.

videos.title: Dirtfoot
videos.overview: Shake pretends to fall down a well, where he meets the legendary New Jersey monster known as Dirtfoot.

videos.title: Boost Mobile
videos.overview: Shake sells himself out to Boost Mobile, and now is forced to endlessly plug the service.

videos.title: Star Studded Christmas Spectacular (1)
videos.overview: Master Shake reviews deleted scenes from the upcoming Aqua Teen movie.

videos.title: Star Studded Christmas Spectacular (2)
videos.overview: Part 2 of the deleted scenes from the Aqua Teen movie, hosted by Master Shake.

videos.title: Dickesode
videos.overview: Carl suffers the consequences for ordering fast food at Wong Burger. Apparently, the owner Mr. Wong has a diabolical plan.

videos.title: Handbanana
videos.overview: Frylock creates a genetically mutated dog for Meatwad named Handbanana, who soon begins to periodically rape Carl.

videos.title: Party All the Time
videos.overview: Andrew W.K. guest stars in this very special episode about tragedy, courage and ultimately, redemption.

videos.title: Global Grilling
videos.overview: Shake purchases an environmentally unfriendly grill.

videos.title: Grim Reaper Gutters
videos.overview: Clips from older shows are used. The Aqua Teens talk a lot about their past experiences. Carl goes crazy after finding out that Tara the porn star is visiting the Aqua Teens. He then runs into the grim reaper who poses as a gutter salesman.

videos.title: Moonajuana
videos.overview: The Mooninites get Shake and Meatwad high by burning tires. Frylock doesn't fall for this trick and later the Mooninites finally explain to him why they have been pulling all of these pranks.

videos.title: Bart Oates
videos.overview: Carl receives a visit from his favorite football star.

videos.title: Antenna
videos.overview: Frylock investigates the mysterious alien antenna built atop Carl's house. What part does professional voice artist George Lowe play in the puzzle?

videos.title: Ezekial
videos.overview: Shake takes on the greatest role of his life: that of a father.

videos.title: Carl Wash
videos.overview: Two floating brains (calling themselves Carl) hire Meatwad to advertise their dilapidated car wash. He is unable to attract customers, so with Shake's help, they get Carl to take his car in. The brains wreck his car, gas him, and remove his brain.

videos.title: Robots Everywhere
videos.overview: When the Aqua Teens are chased out of there house, Carl tries to sell it. A bunch of robots move in and they are annoying Carl, and Carl is doing everything he can to stop them.

videos.title: Sirens
videos.overview: When a trio of sirens move in, their wanton songs pique Carl's attention.

videos.title: Couples Skate
videos.overview: The Aqua Teens must either escape the spider cocoons their landlord Marcula has trapped them in, or pay the rent they owe him, while Carl gets a new neighbor, a huge demon named Paul who is going through a difficult custody battle.

videos.title: Reedickyoulus
videos.overview: Carl's new male enhancement device produces some unsavory side effects.

videos.title: Hoppy Bunny
videos.overview: Carl's home becomes a haven for furries.

videos.title: Laser Lenses
videos.overview: Master Shake's megalomania soars to new heights once he steals Frylock's laser-shooting contact lenses.

videos.title: Dummy Love
videos.overview: A murderous ventriloquist dummy finds out that his favorite internal organ is the heart.

videos.title: The Marines
videos.overview: When Meatwad unwittingly enlists the Aqua Teens into the Marine Corps, Frylock flees the country.

videos.title: Bible Fruit
videos.overview: Frylock decides to party with some friends he met through a social networking website.

videos.title: Gene E.
videos.overview: Master Shake discovers a genie at the dump who promises to grant wishes, but instead turns the Aqua Teens invisible. After inadvertently killing him, they discover a shrunken Carl. Meatwad and Frylock try to restore their visibility, while Carl and Master Shake use their cursed states to spy on women.

videos.title: Shake Like Me
videos.overview: Master Shake is bitten by a radioactive black man and becomes black. Boxy Brown trys to make him a super star.

videos.title: She Creature
videos.overview:
A strange monster is inhabiting Carl's pool, and the Aqua Teens attempt to get to the bottom of the mystery. It turns out to be a mermaid, who has sex with Carl, Frylock, and Meatwad, who all explode as a result of being impregnated by the mermaid. Master Shake, meanwhile, does not explode, despite describing his supposed sexual encounter with the mermaid to no one, as they have exploded.

Special Guests Vincent Pastore provides the voice of Terry (uncredited) and Dana Swanson as the She Creature

videos.title: Chick Magnet
videos.overview: Shake buys a magnet to attract women from a TV commercial. Shake does not put in a screw that came with the magnet, so it merely brings out the feminine side of the Aqua Teens.

videos.title: Creature From Plaque Lagoon
videos.overview: Meatwad and Shake are set out to capture the Tooth Fairy.

videos.title: Time Machine
videos.overview: Frylock builds a time machine, but things don't go according to plan.

videos.title: 2-And-A-Half Star Wars out of Five
videos.overview: A Pink Man tries to blow up the moon. Features a full-fledged orchestral score.

videos.title: Fry Legs
videos.overview: Frylock begins acting strangely after falling in love with a girl.

videos.title: Der Inflatable Fuhrer
videos.overview: Frylock takes up some side work.

videos.title: The Last Last One Forever and Ever
videos.overview: The Aqua Teens find out that there is a fire in the water.

videos.title: A PE Christmas
videos.overview: The Aqua Teens are going to release a Christmas album, but first, they have to steal an identity!

videos.title: Rabbot Redux
videos.overview: After moving into their new crib, the Aqua Teens re-unite with some old friends.

videos.title: Rubberman
videos.overview: Carl starts raking used condoms onto the Aqua Teens' yard, giving Frylock the idea to make a duck out of them. Meatwad accidentally brings him to life but unfortunately finds him to be a bad role model.

videos.title: Eggball
videos.overview: Master Shake builds a pinball machine designed after himself. He runs out of pinballs, and the Aqua Teens travel to Death Island to collect pinball eggs from a flightless bird.

videos.title: Monster
videos.overview: Meatwad is terrified of the monsters living in the house, so Frylock tries to help him come to terms with it. Shake tries to make things worse.

videos.title: Hands on a Hamburger
videos.overview: The Aqua Teens compete in a contest at a suspiciously-familiar burger chain, unaware that they are pawns in Dr. Wongburger's latest scheme.

videos.title: IAMAPOD
videos.overview: A pod attempts to replicate Shake and then follow Chickenfoot  on the road.

videos.title: Juggalo
videos.overview: Guest stars the Insane Clown Posse.

videos.title: Multiple Meat
videos.overview: Master Shake cuts Meatwad into pieces as punishment for a crime neither can remember, only to find every chunk retains his consciousness.

videos.title: Kangarilla and the Magic Tarantula
videos.overview: Master Shake and Frylock become addicted to a cell phone game which is unfortunate timing for the ghosts that haunt them since cell phones kill the ghosts.

videos.title: Larry Miller Hair System
videos.overview: Larry Miller gives Carl a glimpse of what his life would be like...with HAIR!

videos.title: One Hundred
videos.overview: The 100th episode. Plot revolves around a parody of the Mayan '2012' prophecy and the '23' Enigma. Dana Snyder breaks character to get syndication money. The second half is a parody of the old Scooby Doo cartoon.

videos.title: Allen (1)
videos.overview: Master Shake awakens to a surprise after a stint in a hyper-sleep chamber.

videos.title: Allen (2)
videos.overview: Master Shake faces the future ruler of Earth.

videos.title: Intervention
videos.overview: Carl must face the consequences of his drinking.

videos.title: Freedom Cobra
videos.overview: Master Shake gets a tattoo that is alive and controls him.

videos.title: The Creditor
videos.overview: Shake encounters financial woes that could have disastrous results.

videos.title: Vampirus
videos.overview: A vampire virus devastates the world, but the guys may have a cure.

videos.title: Wi-Tri
videos.overview: Frylock gets a smartphone.

videos.title: Jumpy George
videos.overview: Shake and Carl date the same woman simultaneously.

videos.title: Lasagna
videos.overview: Shake's lasagna tempts Carl.

videos.title: Last Dance For Napkin Lad
videos.overview: It's all cloaks and daggers until somebody gets hurt.  And someone will!

videos.title: Big Bro
videos.overview: Not much is known yet, other than Frylock is playing with Gerald, a nine year old kid, presumed to be Carl's son, and they are building a soap-box derby racer reminiscent of 2 Wycked, when Carl breaks down and destroys it. It is then that Gerald's mother pulls over in the car, presumed to be a hooker Carl knocked up.

videos.title: Chicken and Beans
videos.overview: Meatwad indulges into projectile vomiting while performing on stage with Frylock. This instantly makes him a viral hit on the Internet, giving him fame and fortune, a new band, and a massive ego.

videos.title: Shirt Herpes
videos.overview: Shake gets a mythical shirt that takes him back to the land of dragons where he rules as their king.

videos.title: Rocket Horse & Jet Chicken
videos.overview: Meatwad writes and draws a graphic novel about him performing surgery, in hopes that Shake will write a promotional blurb about it.

videos.title: The Granite Family
videos.overview: Shake is offered a tour to the White House, however, he wanders off into the president's office and causes a potentially apocalyptic missile strike on the Earth in order to recreate his favorite televison series, The Granite Family. The Aqua Somethings require safety so they go with Carl in his bomb shelter.

videos.title: Bookie
videos.overview: Master Shake bets on the house for pro-football, causing chaos with Shake as Terry and his assistant try to kill him.

videos.title: Fightan Titan
videos.overview: The Aqua Somethings must assemble and pilot an ancient, giant robot to defeat an old foe.

videos.title: Buddy Nugget
videos.overview: Frylock's revolutionary social networking device summons a pre-release party of staggeringly douchebaggy proportions.

videos.title: Zucotti Manicotti
videos.overview: Meatwad is visited by his favorite puppet star.

videos.title: Totem Pole
videos.overview: A heavy metal band has a strange request.

videos.title: Muscles
videos.overview: Shake decides to get into shape by drinking an illegal fitness beverage after a health scare.

videos.title: The Dudies
videos.overview: Carl helps Shake train for the title of 'Coolest Dude Ever.

videos.title: Merlo Sauvignon Blanco
videos.overview: Shake must attend an intervention for his crippling addiction to shellfish.

videos.title: Banana Planet
videos.overview: The Teens answer a distress signal from the mysterious Banana Planet while Master Shake is preoccupied with a honeybaked ham.

videos.title: Working Stiffs
videos.overview: Meatwad and Master Shake must earn money to get the cable turned back on by doing the unthinkable.

videos.title: Skins
videos.overview: Master Shake joins a drum circle. The Aqua backyard is home to yet another screaming specter summoned through the power of bongo beats.

videos.title: Freda
videos.overview: Master Shake falls for the perfect woman.

videos.title: Storage Zeebles
videos.overview: Carl buys the contents of a storage unit to make a quick buck, and he comes across an amazing discovery.

videos.title: Piranha Germs
videos.overview: On a very special Aqua TV Show Show, we explore the deadly potential of viral marketing.

videos.title: Spacecadeuce
videos.overview: Emory and Oglethorpe emerge from hypersleep only to learn that the duplicitous Mooninites have enslaved their entire race, the Plutonians. In order ease their boredom, the capricious Ignignokt and Err instruct Emory and Oglethorpe to investigate a living spaceship that is said to be carnivorous.

videos.title: Brain Fairy
